question: What should the canonical walker worktree base path be for v0.6.1? The dogfood landed on ~/.cache/cloverleaf/walker/<plan-id>-<task-id>/ as a working workaround. Should the shipped default be that path, $XDG_CACHE_HOME/cloverleaf/walker/ for portability, or <repoRoot>/.cloverleaf/runs/walker/ for consumer-locality? The answer determines what is written into the SKILL.md template for bug #1 and whether the acceptance harness needs to create the ~/.cache directory hierarchy in CI.
